request: Support functools.partial in Tool.function. Use the underlying function's default name/docstring and type hints, with the partial's actual bound signature. Honor explicit name/description overrides. Keep lambda naming rules and reserved llm_tool_call injection unchanged. Support nested partials and both positional/keyword binding.

Add optional case-sensitive --name-prefix to tools list. Filter top-level function tool, toolbox, and server-side tool names before rendering either JSON or text. Keep the default unfiltered behavior, deterministic ordering, tool definitions, and model selection intact; do not invoke tool implementations when listing.

Render tool-call arguments as indented, sorted, Unicode-preserving JSON in the CLI approval prompt. Keep the Tool call: label and tool name, yes/no confirmation, denial behavior, and callback wiring intact.
